cards.title: Family Sexual Abuse: How to Respond
cards.body: A young adult's disclosure of childhood sexual abuse requires creating safety and allowing her to share at her own pace. Consider any ongoing danger the perpetrator poses to younger family members.

cards.title: Taking Toddlers to Music Festivals Works
cards.body: Bringing young children to festivals enriches the experience rather than spoils it. Parents who brave events with toddlers often find families add genuine magic to shared celebrations.

cards.title: Empty Nesting: The Denial Is Real
cards.body: Parents experience profound grief when adult children leave home, despite knowing this is a natural life transition. The emotional impact often surprises parents who thought they were prepared.

cards.title: Climate Change Adds Stress to Parenting
cards.body: Extreme heat and climate events intensify pressure on families already stretched thin by daily demands. Understanding this connection helps parents acknowledge real stressors affecting their households.

cards.title: Why Rewards Undermine Child Motivation
cards.body: Rewards secure compliance but can destroy intrinsic motivation when removed. Research shows external incentives may harm genuine long-term motivation in children.

cards.title: Postpartum Pet Aversion: Support Available
cards.body: Some parents experience sudden aversion to beloved pets after pregnancy, causing shame and confusion. Understanding this phenomenon and seeking help eases family strain during vulnerable transitions.

cards.title: Stay-At-Home Sons Reflect Changing Adulthood
cards.body: More adult children live with parents, reflecting evolving definitions of independence and economic realities. This trend raises questions about modern family support structures and expectations.

cards.title: Can Ending Marriage Save the Family?
cards.body: Some parents explore separation while co-parenting rather than full divorce to support children. This middle path offers benefits but isn't viable for all families.

cards.title: Crocodile Attack Survivor, 3, Returns Home
cards.body: A young boy who survived a crocodile attack after undergoing seven surgeries has returned home from hospital. His family reports he is happy and recovering well.
